title: ME40406: Turbo-Machinery
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite ; Heat TransferAxial flow compressors: flow through cascades,
cascade terminology, flow separation, radial equilibrium theory, actuator disc
theory, effect of tip clearance, secondary flow, performance characteristics,
surging and stalling. Axial flow turbine: vortex theory, blade design, cooling
of turbine blades, performance characteristics. profile loss, secondary flow
loss, annulus loss, tip clearance loss. limiting factors in turbine design.
Applications: gas turbine power plant, aircraft propulsion.
